method: tinycss2 recursively parsed rules. A rule is removed only when every comma-separated selector branch requires at least one manually allowlisted legacy class absent from all 22 manifest HTML pages and every current JS file loaded by those pages. Only top-level class selectors count; classes inside :not/:is/etc are not used as proof. Mixed selector lists and selectors mentioning protected components are retained. Existing font family files and weights are unchanged.
